declaredTranslator: M. Muhsin Khan in EPUB metadata and main introduction
scopeOfAudit: All 97 section documents inventoried in EPUB spine order; every paragraph retains raw byte spans and decoded-text hashes. This verifies extraction coverage, not source accuracy or completeness against a published edition.
findings: The front acknowledgement names Abdul Hamid Siddiqui while the EPUB metadata and main introduction name M. Muhsin Khan. Record and investigate this inconsistency rather than silently correcting the credit.
References use volume/book/report IDs. They must not be equated with modern continuous Arabic hadith numbering.
The opening narrator introductions are abbreviated, not the complete Arabic narrator chain requested for the app.
The main introduction forbids commercial copying/use. This does not by itself settle AI narration or all redistribution questions.

Legacy FAQ/disclaimer notices are retained as context. The current official developer policy explicitly permits unchanged attributed offline/app reuse without prior permission; retain the EPUB-specific noncommercial condition.
The downloaded text is not established as identical to the Darussalam publisher sample.
The complete paragraph inventory found seven narrator-only report bodies. This EPUB is not an acceptable complete source without resolving its omissions against authoritative witnesses.

currentPolicy.finding: The current official developer policy expressly permits downloading, unchanged republication, offline storage, and app use with attribution/version retention and updates. It says prior permission is not required when the policy is followed. This is content-policy evidence, not treating the repository MIT license as a license to third-party books.
currentPolicy.scopeNotes: Retain the EPUB-specific prohibition on commercial use. This project is personal/noncommercial. Translator-credit conflict, completeness, exact source preservation and Arabic-chain mapping remain unresolved; AI narration has not been approved as accurate.

findings: Books 59 and 60 each occupy two section documents; preserve both sections in reading order.
Seven report headings are followed only by a narrator introduction. Their missing narration bodies were confirmed in original EPUB markup.
The source contains additional transcription defects; the inventory does not certify all remaining bodies as correct.
